title: Requirement that pulls a non-runtime extra
description: requirements.txt declares an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
limitation: It matches an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
